title: Validation simulation (Da=1440)
action: Set up a 2D D2Q9 LB model with volumetric reactive boundary for diffusion only. Use a rectangular domain of 125x100 lattice units with reaction at the upper boundary, constant concentration at x=0, no-flux elsewhere, parameters D_m=3.47e-3, k_m=0.05 (Da=1440). Run to steady state and output the concentration at every node.
description: Steady-state solute concentration field for the reactive boundary benchmark (Da=1440).
output_schema: CSV with columns: x (integer, 0..124), y (integer, 0..99), concentration (float).

title: Scaling analysis and parameter setup
action: Using temperature T = -15°C, pressure p = 900 mbar, condensation coefficient χ = 0.1, compute physical parameters: saturation concentration over ice, diffusivity, kinetic rate constant, and the fundamental length scale λ_p. Then using scaling relations and the LB model constants (l_m=100, D_m=0.0104), compute the required k_m values that yield Da = 16 and Da = 400. Store all computed parameters.
description: Computation of model parameters (k_m, D_m) for the two Damköhler numbers used in the growth simulations.

title: Random growth simulation Da=16
action: On a 100x100 lattice, initialize a small seed crystal at the centre. Set supersaturation S = 1.20 (C_far = S * C_sat) and LB parameters from previous step for Da=16. Use the volumetric reactive boundary scheme with random growth rule. Run simulation for 750,000 time steps. Output the final solid mass at every lattice node.
description: Final solid mass array after crystal growth at Da=16, S=1.20, T=-15°C.
output_schema: CSV with columns: x (integer, 0..99), y (integer, 0..99), solid_mass (float).

title: Random growth simulation Da=400
action: Repeat the growth simulation for Da=400 using the parameters from previous step, all other conditions identical (100x100 lattice, S=1.20, T=-15°C, random growth, 750,000 time steps). Output the final solid mass array.
description: Final solid mass array after crystal growth at Da=400, S=1.20, T=-15°C.
output_schema: CSV with columns: x (integer, 0..99), y (integer, 0..99), solid_mass (float).

title: Compute fractal dimensions
action: From the two solid mass arrays, binarise by thresholding (solid node if mass >= 0.5). Compute the box-counting fractal dimension D_f for each crystal using square box sizes from 1 to the grid size. Output the two fractal dimensions.
description: Box-counting fractal dimensions of the crystals grown at Da=16 and Da=400.

title: Compute theoretical dendrite spacing limit
action: Using the physical parameters and the simulation conditions, evaluate the critical wavelength λ_c from the surface-vapor-layer model (equation relating diffusion and deposition times). Report λ_c in micrometers.
description: Theoretical dendrite spacing limit λ_c derived from the surface-vapor-layer model.
output_schema: JSON object with key 'lambda_c' (float, units µm).
